title: k-Nearest Neighbors Classifier
signature: def knn_predict(X_train: np.ndarray, y_train: np.ndarray, X_test: np.ndarray, k: int) -> np.ndarray
hints: Compute the full (m, n) matrix of squared distances with broadcasting. Squared distances give the same ordering as distances.
np.argsort(D, axis=1, kind="stable") orders neighbors by distance and breaks distance ties by the lower training index.
np.bincount(...).argmax() breaks vote ties by the smallest label, which is not the rule here. Walk the k neighbors from nearest to farthest and return the first whose class has the top vote count.
